text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"“Although there are some setbacks…” thesis in the introduction","quality":"clear stance","description":"It states an arguable position early and signals the direction of the essay."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on liability, cost, and benefits","quality":"organization","description":"It develops its claim in distinct sections that move from concerns to advantages to a conclusion."},{"evidence":"“If the technology fails… who is at fault?” and “initial cost…”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It draws on multiple specific details from the article to support its points."},{"evidence":"counterargument followed by “On the contrast…” rebuttal","quality":"argument balance","description":"It acknowledges opposing concerns and then directly answers them instead of only listing positives."},{"evidence":"“there are many more advantages and possibilities” and repeated persuasive emphasis","quality":"development","description":"It expands ideas with explanation rather than stopping at brief statements."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of benefits and call for development","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by clearly revisiting the main claim and reinforcing why the position matters."}]}
